title: a16z Podcast: E-commerce, Payments, & More in India's Evolving Retail Landscape

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: So many modern e-commerce sites and marketplaces are really digital forms of their physical counterparts.
reader_summary.overview: So many modern e-commerce sites and marketplaces are really digital forms of their physical counterparts. But in India. So how do these new companies connect people to products when the logistics infrastructure hasn't been built out yet? (Imagine if instead of just partnering with carriers, Amazon had had to build not just its services, but delivery, from scratch in the United States!) Similarly.
